stories.title: «Personne n’est vraiment surpris» : les messages antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella vus par la presse étrangère

en.title: "No one is really surprised": antisemitic messages attributed to Jordan Bardella seen by foreign press
en.summary: Following Mediapart's revelations about antisemitic remarks allegedly made by the National Rally leader, foreign media outlets note the damage to Marine Le Pen's efforts to rebrand the party as mainstream.

stories.title: France-Italie : un classique de légende pour enflammer le Stade de France… et émouvoir Zidane

en.title: France-Italy: a legendary classic to set the Stade de France on fire... and move Zidane
en.summary: The new France coach faces Italy on Friday at the stadium where he built his legend, following two opening victories in his managerial tenure.

stories.title: Propos antisémites de Jordan Bardella : Mediapart publie ses preuves après les démentis du RN

en.title: Jordan Bardella's antisemitic remarks: Mediapart publishes its evidence after RN denials
en.summary: Mediapart released additional evidence supporting its investigation into antisemitic messages allegedly sent by Jordan Bardella in 2013, stating they were authenticated, while Bardella denies the claims and announces a new lawsuit.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella "fait preuve des clichés antisémites les plus rances qui existent", commente Eric Coquerel après les nouvelles révélations de Mediapart

en.title: Jordan Bardella "displays the most banal antisemitic clichés that exist", comments Eric Coquerel after Mediapart's new revelations
en.summary: Following Mediapart's authentication of antisemitic messages attributed to Jordan Bardella, whom he denies sending them, an LFI lawmaker states that Mediapart typically has full evidence before publishing investigations.

stories.title: "Je n'ai pas de regrets"... Vingt ans après son coup de tête, Zinédine Zidane retrouve l’Italie, qui a aussi façonné sa légende

en.title: "I have no regrets"... Twenty years after his headbutt, Zinédine Zidane faces Italy again, which also shaped his legend
en.summary: France plays Italy at the Stade de France on Friday in the third round of the Nations League. Zidane returns to Italy two decades after the 2006 World Cup final, now as France's coach.

stories.title: Propos antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : le président du RN "ment éhontément", accuse Gérald Darmanin

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella: RN president "shamelessly lies", accuses Gérald Darmanin
en.summary: France's Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin criticized Jordan Bardella, the National Rally leader, for allegedly lying to the French public. Darmanin questioned Bardella's fitness for political office based on his strategy of deception.

stories.title: Propos antisémites de Jordan Bardella : la droite reste prudente malgré des « preuves accablantes » présentées par « Mediapart »

en.title: Antisemitic remarks by Jordan Bardella: the right remains cautious despite "damning evidence" presented by Mediapart
en.summary: Republicans have largely remained silent on allegations against Bardella, though Mediapart published additional evidence. Recent disclosures may prompt the right-wing party to shift its position as it navigates its rivalry with the far-left.

stories.title: Ligue des nations : Zidane retrouve l’Italie et le Stade de France

en.title: Nations League: Zidane faces Italy and the Stade de France
en.summary: Zinédine Zidane encounters Italy on Friday as France's coach in the Nations League, twenty years after the 2006 World Cup final. He returns to the Stade de France for his first match in that venue as national team selector.

stories.title: Cédric Jubillar : une reconstitution de la nuit du meurtre de Delphine Aussaguel organisée dans la maison du couple

en.title: Cédric Jubillar: a reconstruction of the night of Delphine Aussaguel's murder organized at the couple's home
en.summary: Authorities are conducting a reconstruction at the home to determine whether the crime was spontaneous or premeditated ahead of Jubillar's appeal trial scheduled for April 30 to May 14 in Toulouse. He was sentenced to 30 years imprisonment and faces life imprisonment on appeal.

stories.title: Du terrain d’élection au terrain de sélection, Zinédine Zidane de retour au Stade de France contre l’Italie

en.title: From election ground to selection ground, Zinédine Zidane returns to the Stade de France against Italy
en.summary: New France manager Zidane returns to the stadium where he built his legendary career, following two victories in his opening matches as coach.

stories.title: Salaire des enseignants, impôt sur la fortune, dividendes... On a vérifié six affirmations des candidats à la primaire de la gauche lors de leur débat

en.title: Teacher salaries, wealth tax, dividends... We verified six claims made by left-wing primary candidates during their debate
en.summary: Franceinfo fact-checked statements made by five left-wing candidates debating on television regarding economic and social policy proposals.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées, affaire Bardella, guerre à Gaza... Sept séquences à retenir du débat des candidats à la primaire de la gauche

en.title: High school blockades, Bardella controversy, Gaza war... Seven sequences to remember from the left primary candidates debate
en.summary: Five left primary candidates debated major political issues including school blockades, a political controversy, and international conflicts one week before the first round of voting.

stories.title: Dans le viseur : calendrier spatial octobre-décembre

en.title: In focus: space calendar October-December
en.summary: A selection of major space events expected to occur through the end of the year are highlighted for attention.

stories.title: Innov'Camp : À Dunkerque, ArcelorMittal ouvre sa 5G industrielle aux entreprises locales

en.title: Innov'Camp: In Dunkerque, ArcelorMittal opens its industrial 5G to local businesses
en.summary: ArcelorMittal inaugurated Innov'Camp on 30 September, a facility combining an incubator and campus dedicated to digital transitions. The initiative targets startups, SMEs, industrial companies and port operators, at a time when France has only sixteen industrial 5G networks.

stories.title: OPINION. « Le front commence dans les usines »

en.title: OPINION. "The front begins in the factories"
en.summary: This opinion argues that military autonomy depends not only on military leadership but also on productive capacity in factories, workshops and laboratories, given challenges to nuclear deterrence and modern conflicts.

stories.title: Qu'est-ce que le leasing social des pompes à chaleur ?

en.title: What is social leasing of heat pumps?
en.summary: The French government is launching a social leasing program for heat pumps to accelerate residential heating electrification. The state will provide financial support for installing these environmentally friendlier alternatives to heating oil and gas.

stories.title: À Mérignac, Thales inaugure son centre consacré à la sécurité des vols

en.title: At Mérignac, Thales inaugurates its flight safety center
en.summary: Thales has opened the Flight Safety Center at its Bordeaux-Mérignac facility to establish flight safety culture among new employees. The company recruits an average of over 300 people annually at this location alone.
